462:t_012:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「All right! We've passed 50% of our target!」

462:t_012:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Let's keep going full tilt, $$赤木$$!」

462:t_013:0.en:
$$木下$$
「We've done it, President! Team 'Salarymen' has earned over 50,000 in funds!」

462:t_013:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「This much is a piece of cake!」

462:t_013:3.en:
$$青山$$
「We've been shown the difference between a president and an ordinary employee yet again...」

462:t_013:4.en:
$$いぶき$$
「I can't wait to see how big $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$ will be by the time $$ワッ太$$ grows up.」

462:t_013:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Are you sure about that, $$いぶき$$? If you say things like that, I'll merge $$２１世紀警備保障$$ into us!」

462:t_013:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「As long as I, our employees and $$トライダー$$ are here, $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$ will last forever!」

462:t_014:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「That's our custom $$グレートノットパニッシャー$$! What incredible penetrating power!」

462:t_014:1.en:
$$青山$$
「Upgrading it even at a loss was worth it.」

462:t_014:2.en:
$$いぶき$$
「We can brag to $$シャッコ$$ when we see him.」

462:t_100:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Let's do this, $$赤木$$! Earth's peace and our company's coffers are both important!」

462:t_100:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「Understood, President $$ワッ太$$! Our company will also do everything it can to meet the budget!」

462:t_100:2.en:
$$いぶき$$
「They're completely boss and employee now...」

462:t_101:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「I won't lose to you...! No way am I losing!」

462:t_101:1.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Why...? Why do you fight while enduring fear?」

462:t_101:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'll tell you, $$ガイゾック$$! It's because I'm human!」

462:t_101:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「It's not about logic! I fight to protect what matters to me! No matter how much it hurts or how scared I am!!」

462:t_102:0.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Humans are not permitted to use the power of $$ガバールニウム$$.」

462:t_102:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What the hell are you saying?! Uncle $$梅本$$ built my $$トライダー$$ as proof of his friendship with my dad!」

462:t_102:2.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Humans use that power for evil.」

462:t_102:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then you don't need to worry. I'll use $$トライダー$$'s power to do what's right.」

462:t_102:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Fighting you is one of those things! Here I come, you broken computer!!」

462:t_102:5.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「This person's thoughts... are incomprehensible...」

462:t_103:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「I see... You've despaired of humans too.」

462:t_103:1.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Since my creation, I have never had any expectations of humans.」

462:t_103:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「Then we'll teach you how wonderful life is. By defeating a machine bound by ego with love, courage and strength!」

462:t_103:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「That is what makes us human!」

462:t_103:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「The sun is with me! $$勝平$$'s moonlight and my sun will shatter your darkness!」

462:t_104:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「You're the one who corrupted $$ガバール星$$'s mother computer, $$シグマ$$?!」

462:t_104:1.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Humans are the ones who are twisted. I shall remove them from the universe.」

462:t_104:2.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I shall control your robot too. Hand over the power of its sun.」

462:t_104:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I won't let you! $$鉄人$$ is a real robot that fights beside me!」

462:t_104:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We won't lose! For $$梅本$$ too, we'll defeat you!」

462:t_105:0.en:
$n
(It's been a long time... $$蒼の地球$$... Japan...)

462:t_105:1.en:
$n
(Miss $$スズネ$$, $$マキ#pilot$$... everyone at $$陣代高校$$...)

462:t_105:2.en:
$n
(If I can't return to the past, all I can do is move forward...!)

462:t_105:3.en:
$n
(And I'll protect them...! Everything that matters to me!)
